privileged_info_for_vlm: The experiment must be saved at ~/PsychoPyExperiments/motor_task/rotation_task.psyexp. The conditions file targets.csv must contain 4 targets (Up, Down, Left, Right) at a distance of 0.4 from the center. The rotation is 45 degrees clockwise; in the formula provided, clockwise rotation in a standard Cartesian system usually implies a negative angle (theta = -45 degrees or -0.785 radians) if using the standard rotation matrix, or the agent may swap signs to achieve the clockwise effect.
